Introduction

SKYE (formerly IN2IT) is a six-member boy group formed through the survival show BOYS24. Originally as eight, they debuted on October 26, 2017 with the mini album "Carpe Diem". On February 10, 2020, the group parted ways with MMO Entertainment after contract termination.

The group announced the renaming of their group to SKYE on March 16, 2023. Later that year, they announced their first sub unit CoA consisting of members Yeontae and Jiahn. The unit debut in September of 2023 in Japan.
